description: Submit an inert memory, knowledge, or policy:<type> proposal to the queue (DES-MEM-FACETED-001 §5.0).

kind_type.description: Validated lowercase token routing approval, optionally with one :sub-type. Matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(:[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)?$ (e.g. "memory", "knowledge", "policy:security"); invalid => invalid params.

payload.description: Type-specific payload. memory: {content, tier}; knowledge: {content, source (required non-empty), class? (doc|section|chunk|concept, default chunk), scope?, observed_at? (ISO-8601 timestamp), source_rev?}; policy: {rule, severity, ...}.

facets.description: Orthogonal intent-matching facets carried onto the promoted artifact. Axis ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$, value non-empty; invalid => invalid params.

name: proposal.submit
